explication: 12306 购票小助手 automates ticket search and booking. The principal workflow is configured launch, login and passenger loading, repeated availability checks, order submission, queue polling, then success notification; it also supports waitlist booking and automated CAPTCHA recognition. The architecture separates orchestration, railway-interface stages, networking, and notifications. Relationships are based on the README and SOURCE INDEX references; unsampled modules are represented only where documented, and external railway-service interaction is shown as unverified.
